categories.name: Basic Chemicals
categories.short: Chlor-alkali and peroxide chemicals produced at scale in our Gazaria complex, from caustic soda to hydrogen peroxide.

categories.name: Performance Chemicals
categories.short: Samuda's own branded textile auxiliaries — softeners, wetting agents, stabilizers and more for pretreatment, dyeing and finishing.

categories.name: Calcium Carbonate
categories.short: Coated and uncoated calcium carbonate and ready-to-use filler compounds for plastics, paper, paints and construction.

products.name: Caustic Soda
products.short: High-purity sodium hydroxide in 45% liquid and 98–99% flake form, made by ion-exchange membrane electrolysis.
overview: Caustic soda is produced in Samuda's chlor-alkali plant using ion-exchange membrane technology, which delivers superior product quality with low energy consumption.
It is available as a 45% liquid delivered by tank lorry, and as 98–99% flakes packed in airtight poly-woven bags.
products.packaging: Liquid by tank lorry; flakes in 25 kg and 50 kg airtight poly-woven bags
products.storage: Long shelf life when kept away from air and contamination.

products.name: Hydrogen Peroxide
products.short: Technical-grade hydrogen peroxide in 35%, 50% and 60% concentrations — the most economical grade for industrial use.
overview: Samuda technical-grade hydrogen peroxide is usually the most economical grade for industrial applications in which inorganic stabilizers are accepted.

It is a clear, colorless, slightly viscous liquid, miscible with water in all proportions. It decomposes to water and oxygen with no toxic residues; decomposition is normally slow (below 1% per year) but is accelerated by heat and by catalysts such as transition metals, strong acids and strong alkalis.
applications: Detoxifying phenolics and reduced sulfur compounds

products.name: Liquid Chlorine
products.short: 99.5% pure liquid chlorine supplied in 100 kg, 930 kg and 1,000 kg cylinders.
overview: Liquid chlorine is a co-product of Samuda's chlor-alkali process. It appears as a yellowish-green gas or amber liquid and is supplied in pressure cylinders for disinfection and chemical manufacturing.
products.packaging: Cylinders of 1,000 kg, 930 kg and 100 kg
applications: Sterilizing service water, drainage and swimming pools

products.name: Hydrochloric Acid
products.short: 32% minimum hydrochloric acid for metal treatment, water treatment and chemical manufacturing.
overview: Hydrochloric acid is a clear, colorless to slightly yellowish liquid with a pungent odor. Samuda supplies it at a minimum purity of 32% w/w with very low free chlorine.
products.packaging: Rubber-lined tank lorry or plastic tank
products.storage: Rubber-lined tanks, plastic, FRP or PVC vessels and containers.
applications: Dyestuff, casein, pharmaceuticals and synthetic rubber

products.name: Sodium Hypochlorite
products.short: Clear to greenish-yellow bleach and disinfectant with 4–12.5% available chlorine.
overview: Sodium hypochlorite is a versatile bleaching and disinfecting agent used from textile mills to water-treatment plants, laundries and households.
products.packaging: Plastic or HDPE containers, or rubber-lined vessels by truck or lorry

products.name: Chlorinated Paraffin Wax
products.short: 45–55% chlorine CPW used as a plasticizer and flame retardant in PVC, rubber and coatings.
overview: Chlorinated paraffin wax is a dense, colorless to straw-yellow liquid used as a plasticizer and flame-retardant additive.
applications: Plasticizer in chlorinated rubber and PVC
Flame retardant in plastics and textiles

products.name: SAMNEU CAN
products.short: An eco-friendly core neutralization acid that holds fabric pH and prevents alkali reversion.
overview: SAMNEU CAN® is an excellent core neutralization acid, free of any mineral or inorganic acid or acid-liberating compounds. It is developed specially for the proper neutralization of textiles after alkaline pretreatment, dyeing and reduction cleaning.
It maintains fabric pH during storage and prevents the fabric from returning to an alkaline condition.
features: 100% eco-friendly and economical
Sulphate, chloride and formate free
Safe in all stages of textile processing
Compatible with enzymes
Non-volatile acetic acid substitute during optical brightening of polyester
Does not affect handle or tone of dyed and printed fabrics
Neutralizes alkali entrapped after mercerization
Prevents yellowing of cotton during drying or stentering
properties: Easily soluble in hot and cold water
Compatible with polyester dye-bath additives and finishing auxiliaries where acidic pH is maintained
At least one year in a dry, cool place in a sealed container
usage: SAMNEU CAN® dilutes readily with cold or warm water to form colorless solutions.
The exact amount depends on the required final pH, residual alkalinity, washing range, fabric quality and the quality of the process water.

products.name: SAMSOF PSS
products.short: A micro-silicone emulsion for a durable, soft, silky and luxurious finish on cotton and blends.
overview: SAMSOF PSS® is a micro-silicone emulsion developed by modifying polydimethylsiloxane, imparting a durable, soft, smooth and silky finish to cotton and its blends. It suits all standard finishing processes and provides a luxurious feel on a wide range of fabrics.
features: Ideal for CO, PC, PES, CV and other synthetic fibers and blends
Durable through multiple washes with a pleasant smoothness
Suitable for white goods; retains brightness of colored fabrics and yarns
Improves crease recovery, tear and abrasion resistance in resin finishing
properties: Easily soluble in hot and cold water
Compatible with anionic and cationic products
At least one year in a dry, cool place in a sealed container
usage: Can be applied by exhaustion or padding. A hydrophilic cationic non-silicone softener can be blended in for a synergistic effect.

products.name: SAMSOF HSS
products.short: A hydrophilic silicone softener for terry towels, knits and garments — soft, silky and absorbent.
overview: SAMSOF HSS® is a hydrophilic silicone softener developed by modifying polysiloxane, imparting a durable, soft, smooth, silky and hydrophilic finish to cotton and its blends.
It is ideal for terry towels, knits and garment finishing, improves crease resistance and sewability, and is suitable for resin baths in wash-and-wear applications.
features: High water retention on cotton knits and terry towels
Durable through multiple washes with a pleasant smoothness
Suitable for white goods; retains brightness of colored fabrics and yarns
Improves crease recovery, tear and abrasion resistance in resin finishing
properties: Easily soluble in hot and cold water
Compatible with nonionic and cationic products; check compatibility with anionic products before use
At least one year in a dry, cool place in a sealed container
usage: Can be applied by exhaustion or padding. A hydrophilic cationic non-silicone softener can be blended in for a synergistic effect.

products.name: SAMSOF HWS
products.short: Hot-water-dispersible nonionic softener flakes for an excellent soft hand on all fiber types.
overview: SAMSOF HWS® is a hot-water-dispersible nonionic softener in free-flowing granular form. It disperses easily, deposits uniformly on cotton, polyester and blends, and gives an excellent soft hand and surface smoothness without impairing the tone of dyed fabrics.
features: Applicable to all fiber types
Disperses with minimal stirring
Very fine particle size for uniform deposition
Significantly improves sewability of knitted goods
Suitable for white fabrics
properties: Easily soluble in hot and cold water
At least one year in a dry, cool place in a sealed container
usage: Prepare a 10% dispersion of the product before use.

products.name: SAMSOF CAT
products.short: Highly cationic softener flakes giving a soft, smooth hand on cotton, polyester and blends.
overview: SAMSOF CAT® is a hot-water-dispersible cationic softener in free-flowing granular form with high cationic charge. It deposits uniformly on cotton, polyester and blends, giving an excellent soft hand and smoothness without impairing the tone of dyed fabrics.
features: Disperses with minimal stirring
Very fine particle size for uniform deposition
Significantly improves sewability of knitted goods
Suitable for white fabrics
properties: Easily soluble in hot and cold water
Compatible with nonionic, amphoteric and cationic products
At least one year in a dry, cool place in a sealed container
usage: Prepare a 10% dispersion of the product before use.

products.name: SAMPER STB
products.short: Silicate-free peroxide stabilizer for high-alkali bleaching in batch and continuous processes.
overview: SAMPER STB® is a peroxide stabilizer for continuous and batch operations in high-alkali bleaching baths. It forms strong, highly stable complexes with iron, nickel, cobalt and other transition metals so they cannot degrade peroxide, and promotes stabilization of active oxygen.
features: Silicate-free, multi-functional product
High caustic and high temperature stability
Efficient stabilization at low concentration
Non-foaming, gives even, good whiteness
properties: Mixture of organic and inorganic compounds
Easily soluble in hot and cold water
Compatible with all detergents, scouring agents and oxidizing agents
At least one year in a dry, cool place in a sealed container
usage: Mixes with cold and warm water in any ratio.

products.name: SAMCRE PAM
products.short: Anti-creasing and lubricating agent that prevents crease marks in all wet processes and machines.
overview: SAMCRE PAM® is a general-purpose anti-creasing and lubricating agent that reduces friction between fiber and fiber, fabric and fabric, and fabric and metal. It reduces defects such as crow's feet and abrasion marks.
Its non-foaming gliding character minimizes crease formation in dyeing acrylic, wool and wool/polyamide blends, silk and cellulosic knit goods.
features: Improves running properties
Protects fabric surfaces and improves dimensional stability
No tonal variation; improves wet fastness of dyeing and printing
Suitable for high-temperature operation
properties: Easily soluble in hot and cold water
Stable to acids, alkalis and salts used in dyeing, and up to 130 °C in polyester/cotton dyeing. Frost changes are reversible on warming and stirring
At least one year in a dry, cool place in a sealed container
usage: Suitable for all major pretreatment, dyeing and finishing processes, on all types of fabrics and machines.

products.name: SAMSEQ USA
products.short: Universal sequestering agent that prevents catalytic damage and iron pinholes and boosts whiteness.
overview: SAMSEQ USA® is a universal sequestering agent with high complex-forming capability for both alkaline-earth and transition metals, giving enhanced peroxide stability.
It is developed especially to prevent catalytic damage and iron pinholes, and is useful in all stages of pretreatment.
features: Outstanding complex-forming and anti-redeposition properties
Prevents the disturbing effect of calcium and magnesium ions during dyeing
Disperses oxidized dyes and improves levelling and fastness
Substantially increases whiteness after peroxide bleaching
Good compatibility with dyes
properties: Easily soluble in hot and cold water
Stable to acid, alkali, hard water and reducing and oxidizing agents at usual concentrations
At least one year in a dry, cool place in a sealed container
usage: Can be used in any step of pretreatment, bleaching and dyeing of cotton.

products.name: SAMWET BLN
products.short: Biodegradable, low-foaming wetting and scouring agent for outstanding hydrophilicity.
overview: SAMWET BLN® is a biodegradable, low-foaming wetting and scouring agent. Its emulsifying and detergency properties make it versatile for scouring and wetting, efficiently removing waxes, oils, grease, dirt and most stains from cotton and blends and making textiles hydrophilic.
features: Environment friendly
Very low foaming — suitable for high-turbulence machines
Outstanding hydrophilicity on treated fabrics
Increases absorbency and whiteness in peroxide bleaching and pretreatment baths
properties: Easily soluble in hot and cold water
At least two years in a dry, cool place in a sealed container

products.name: SAMWET BLF
products.short: Modified low-foaming wetting and scouring agent for batch, semi-continuous and continuous ranges.
overview: SAMWET BLF® is a biodegradable, low-foaming wetting and scouring agent based on modified fatty alcohol ethoxylates. It efficiently removes waxes, oils, grease, dirt and most stains from cotton and blends and makes textiles hydrophilic.
features: Environment friendly
Very low foaming — suitable for high-turbulence machines
Outstanding hydrophilicity on treated fabrics
Increases absorbency and whiteness in peroxide bleaching and pretreatment baths
properties: Easily soluble in hot and cold water
At least two years in a dry, cool place in a sealed container

products.name: Calcium Carbonate Filler Compound
products.short: A high-loading CaCO₃ filler masterbatch for PP and LLDPE that lowers cost and improves surface finish.
overview: Samuda filler compound combines calcium carbonate with resin and additives for polymer processing. It offers a high dosing rate, smooth surface, low moisture and good printability — helping processors save production cost.
features: High dosing rate
Smooth surface finish
Low moisture content
Good printability
Lower production cost
applications: Plastic chairs, bottle caps, bags and baskets

products.name: Calcium Carbonate
products.short: Coated and uncoated calcium carbonate powder for construction, paper, polymers, paints and more.
overview: Samuda produces both uncoated and coated calcium carbonate powder at its dedicated plant, serving a wide range of industries that need a consistent, cost-effective mineral filler.
